TaxType.description: The tax return type. Valid values are: 1040, 1041, 1065, 1120, 990, 5500, 706, or 709.

items.description: The copy types to include in the print job. Multiple copy types can be requested in a single request. For 1120, the value is always P. Valid values are: P (All, applicable for all tax return types), T (Taxpayer), or G (Government).

PdfFileName.description: The file name used to generate the PDF.

RedactText.description: Set to true to redact sensitive data such as EIN and SSN. The default value is false.

IncludeEfileAttachments.description: Set to true to include e-file attachments in the print job. The default value is false.

K1SeparatePackage.description: Applicable only for 1065 tax return types with a K-1 Package (Selection = K-1). The default value is null. Set to true to print K-1 separate packages. Set to false to print each K-1 package as a separate file and bundle all individual packages into a ZIP file. When set to true, the Accept header must be application/zip because this option produces a ZIP file instead of a PDF.

IgnoreK1Prefix.description: Applicable only for 1065 tax return types with a K-1 Package. The default value is null. Set to true to omit the K-1 prefix from generated document names. Set to false to include the K-1 prefix.

SeparateK1ByJurisdiction.description: Applicable only for 1065 tax return types with a K-1 Package. The default value is null. Set to true to separate K-1 packages by jurisdiction. Set to false to group all K-1 packages together.

Name.description: The name of the print tree node.

corpType.description: The corporation type. Applicable only for tax return type 1120. Valid values are: C (1120C), F (1120F), H (1120H), L (1120LIFE), R (1120RIC), S (1120S), T (1120REIT), or Y (1120PC). Leave blank if not applicable.

selection.description: The print selection type. The default value is A. Valid values are: A (All, applicable for all tax return types) or K-1 (K-1 Package, applicable only for 1065 tax return types).
